items.title: প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য: Do / Does / Wh + Auxiliary
items.body:
Why Rima (cry) daily? ⇒ Why does Rima cry daily?
We usually (play) football? ⇒ Do we usually play football?
How you (solve) the problem yesterday? ⇒ How did you solve …?
Where he (live) now? ⇒ Where is he living now?
Who already (go) to the party? ⇒ Who has already gone …?

items.title: অতীত অভ্যাসে always / often / regularly
items.body:
Rima regularly (go) to school. ⇒ Rima regularly went to school.
He (be) always late to his school last year. ⇒ He was always late …

items.title: Future Perfect (shall/will have + V3)
items.body:
I (reach) the station by 4 p.m. ⇒ I shall have reached …
He (meet) the man by the morning. ⇒ He will have met …

items.title: Since-যুক্ত Complex Sentence
items.body:
Many years pass since I (leave) Dhaka. ⇒ … since I left Dhaka.
It has been many years since I (meet) you. ⇒ … since I met you.
It was many days since she (come) here. ⇒ … since she had come here.

items.title: No sooner had … than / Scarcely / Hardly had … when
items.body:
No sooner had he (hear) the sound than he (leave) the room. ⇒ … had he heard … than he left …
Hardly had we (reach) the station when it (begin) raining. ⇒ … reached … began raining.

items.title: Would that / wish / fancy
items.body:
I wish I (draw) picture. ⇒ I wish I drew picture.
Would that I (change) my fate. ⇒ Would that I could change my fate.

items.title: Had better / Had rather / Would rather + V1
items.body:
She had better (shut up) now. ⇒ She had better shut up now.
You would rather (flee) away. ⇒ You would rather flee away.

items.title: Let / Need / Dare + V1
items.body:
I let him (enjoy) the movie. ⇒ I let him enjoy …
How dare you (do) it? ⇒ How dare you do it?
You need not (talk) to me. ⇒ You need not talk to me.

items.title: to be / having + V3
items.body:
Having (take) breakfast, I went to school. ⇒ Having taken breakfast …
The teacher wanted the letter to be (write). ⇒ … to be written.

items.title: Causative Verb: have / get / make / help
items.body:
have + বস্তু + V3: I have my breakfast cooked. I am having my room decorated.
have + ব্যক্তি + V1: I had the boy write the letter. He has the girl wash his clothes.
get + বস্তু + V3: He got his car washed. I get my room painted always.
get + ব্যক্তি + to V1: Kamal got Mitu to help him.
make + obj + V1: The teacher made the students solve the problem.
help + obj + V1 / to V1: I helped the boy write. They helped me to cross the road.

items.title: as if / as though — Tense মিল
items.body:
He acts as if he (not know) anything. ⇒ … he did not know anything.
He came as if he (kill) me. ⇒ … he had killed me.
He commands as if he (be) the captain. ⇒ … he were the captain.

items.title: Indirect Speech: Past reporting verb + next day/week
items.body:
The man told the boy that he (punish) him the next day. ⇒ … he would punish him …
Shilpi said that she (help) the man next week. ⇒ … she would help …

items.title: than / as well as / more than দিয়ে যুক্ত দুই Clause
items.body: I liked him more than he (like) me now. ⇒ … than he likes me now.

items.title: be + to V1 এবং Wh-word + to V1
items.body:
He is (do) the work. ⇒ He is to do the work.
I didn't know what (do). ⇒ … what to do.
He doesn't learn how (read). ⇒ how to read.
